50.title: nested project Git-context capture fails on OpenVMS
50.root_cause: Relative SYS$OUTPUT capture escaped to repository top level when Git changed effective CWD; first attempted fgetname fix also used UNIX-style translated path for a DCL/OpenVMS SYS$OUTPUT consumer. Final fix retains the OpenVMS full filespec and adds graceful llm_git_compose fallback plus real nested-directory regression.

51.summary: AGENT/WRITE composed goal/context can exceed downstream request-builder 8KB limit once a real Git diff is present, even though composer permits much larger context.

52.summary: AGENT/TOOL/RUN PATCH corrupted && operators in replacement text; native PATCH avoided the corruption when the repair was rewritten without &&/||.

53.summary: AGENT/BUILD failure does not persist diagnostics in the OVMS_AGENT_FAILED_BUILD.TXT form required by AGENT/REPAIR/PLAN; repeated build failures yielded 'No failed build output is available.'

observations: Initial nested AGENT/WRITE failed safely before generating any target source.
Raw Git from nested target root worked while OVMS Agent Git capture failed, isolating the wrapper defect.
Interactive SSE tool-call AGENT/WRITE hung at turn 1/12; OVMS_AGENT_NOSTREAM=1 progressed normally.
A 12-turn read-only AGENT/WRITE run falsely summarized proposed edits as completed despite no write.
Workspace approval is required in addition to OVMS_AGENT_WRITE_ENABLED=1; write rejection occurred only after substantial model/tool work.
Guarded-write rollback correctly removed an applied patch when the run hit the turn limit after an unnecessary post-write read.
Human review rejected two plausible but incomplete/incorrect repair proposals before accepting the bounded production fix.
Native PATCH plus full AGENT/BUILD recovered after AGENT/TOOL/RUN PATCH corruption.
Real nested M234 regression initially failed and exposed the OpenVMS-vs-UNIX fgetname consumer mismatch; after correction, full build and live nested acceptance passed.

Nested AGENT/GIT/STATUS reports parent-repository modified paths while nested AGENT/GIT/DIFF reports no unstaged diff, consistent with repository-wide status versus current-subdirectory-scoped git diff --.

standing_rules: At a new chat start read RULES.md from main and CHAT_SESSION_STATE.json from chat-session-state, then verify live GitHub main, active branch and issue state.
Omit literal OVMS-AGENT> from lines intended to paste into OVMS Agent.
GitHub is the development control plane/source of truth; VAX/OpenVMS is authoritative for DEC C/VAX, RMS, DCL, runtime, and generated/uncommitted acceptance.
For M274 target implementation and OVMS Agent self-repair, do not substitute manual/GitHub source edits for the requested OVMS Agent flows. Control-plane issue/state logging is allowed.
Use GITAUTH as the standing prompt-free raw Git network path on VAX/OpenVMS.
Do not use credential.helper=store, global credential.helper, or askpass as standing authentication solutions.
Never mark an untested GitHub head as latest_vax_green_head.
Keep main, chat-session-state, active milestone branch, and only the two most recently completed milestone development branches; permanently tag milestones before pruning older completed branches.
